name: Challenge: A floating selection moves exactly one pixel per arrow and commits as one undoable edit
description: Exercise the compiled local PixiBun build through user controls. Use a desktop viewport. Compare actual artwork and persistent state, not only element visibility. Missing prerequisites or unobservable cancellation must be reported rather than silently skipped.

planSteps.description: Verify restoration has finished and the main drawing canvas is editable.
Draw a short horizontal stroke in the upper-left quarter of the drawing canvas, away from its borders.
Draw a separate short vertical stroke in the lower-right quarter of the drawing canvas.
Verify both strokes exist with transparent space between them; remember their positions and shapes for later comparisons.
Select Box Selection and enclose only the horizontal stroke in the upper-left quarter.
Drag the selected horizontal stroke a small distance to the right to lift it into a floating selection.
Verify the horizontal stroke moves with its gizmo while the vertical stroke stays fixed.
Focus the workspace and press ArrowRight once.
Verify the floating artwork and its selection bounds both move exactly one native canvas pixel to the right, not two pixels; the vertical stroke remains fixed.
Verify the gizmo disappears and the moved horizontal stroke stays in its committed position.
Verify the horizontal stroke returns to its original position before lifting, and the vertical stroke remains unchanged.
Verify the horizontal stroke returns to the committed position and the vertical stroke remains unchanged.
